about: Every language tool in one place, in order of level. Pick who's learning: progress is saved for each person, and it's the same progress as on their own page.

tools.title: French Lab
tools.blurb: One sentence pattern at a time: ask questions, name things, I want, I like, describe, actions, then he / she / we, past and future. About 110 words in 10 stages.

tools.title: Verb Dials
tools.blurb: Turn any sentence through person, tense, negative and question. 37 verbs, six tenses, typed answers and a speed round.

tools.title: Phrase Lab
tools.blurb: Real situations and the structures for them, with conversations to take part in and spaced review.

tools.title: Mandarin Lab
tools.blurb: The same 10-stage ladder as French Lab, with pinyin and measure words: build sentences tile by tile.

tools.title: Mainland Mandarin
tools.blurb: Sound like the mainland: habits to swap, conversation moves, and themes with the words people in China actually use.
